about: Report seam tie-out suite for the Daily Sales PBIP, run by seam.ps1 against the open Desktop model. Each check evaluates two DAX scalar expressions, 'report' (the report's own measures or model state) and 'independent' (a query straight over the fact and date tables, or the expected constant), and fails when they differ. Expressions may be a string or an array of lines. 'tolerance' is an absolute difference allowed between numbers (default 0). 'fingerprint' is evaluated after each of two data refreshes, and the two results must match.

checks.name: date table starts 1 Jul 2023
date table ends 30 Jun 2026
date table has every day of the range, once
29 Feb 2024 is in the date table
29 Feb 2024 has sales
blank-sales days in the whole range
at least one blank-sales day between 7 Jul and 20 Aug 2025
weekdays outsell weekends (mean per day)
report: RETURN AVERAGEX ( FILTER ( __Days, NOT [@Weekend] ), [@Sales] ) > AVERAGEX ( FILTER ( __Days, [@Weekend] ), [@Sales] )

checks.name: December is the highest month of the year (all data)
checks.report: MAXX ( TOPN ( 1, ADDCOLUMNS ( ALL ( 'DimDate'[MonthOfYear] ), "@Sales", [Total Sales] ), [@Sales], DESC ), 'DimDate'[MonthOfYear] )
checks.independent: MAXX ( TOPN ( 1, ADDCOLUMNS ( GROUPBY ( ADDCOLUMNS ( 'Sales', "@Month", MONTH ( 'Sales'[Date] ) ), [@Month], "@Sales", SUMX ( CURRENTGROUP (), 'Sales'[Amount] ) ), "@M", [@Month] ), [@Sales], DESC ), [@M] )

checks.name: December is the highest month of calendar 2025
checks.report: CALCULATE ( MAXX ( TOPN ( 1, ADDCOLUMNS ( VALUES ( 'DimDate'[MonthOfYear] ), "@Sales", [Total Sales] ), [@Sales], DESC ), 'DimDate'[MonthOfYear] ), 'DimDate'[Year] = 2025 )

checks.name: total sales, calendar 2025 (the page filter)
days in filter, calendar 2025
total sales, 7 Jul to 20 Aug 2025 (the probe drag)
days in filter, 7 Jul to 20 Aug 2025
checks.report: CALCULATE ( [Days in Filter], DATESBETWEEN ( 'DimDate'[Date], DATE ( 2025, 7, 7 ), DATE ( 2025, 8, 20 ) ) )

checks.name: helper measure is never blank for a date
checks.report: COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( ALL ( 'DimDate'[Date] ), ISBLANK ( [Days in Filter] ) ) ) + 0

checks.name: helper measure counts every date
checks.independent: COUNTROWS ( ALL ( 'Sales'[Date] ) ) + COUNTROWS ( EXCEPT ( ALL ( 'DimDate'[Date] ), ALL ( 'Sales'[Date] ) ) )
